name: investment-pending-kyc
subject: Investment reserved - identity information being reviewed
previewText: Please provide the required identity information to confirm your investment

fields.heading: Identity information under review
fields.body:
Hi {user_first_name},

Your investment in {pitch_name} has been reserved.

Before we can confirm your investment, we need to verify your identity.

As a regulated investment platform, we are required to complete an identity check as part of efforts to fight financial crime, before you can start investing on Abundance.

Once we have completed our review of your identity information and document for your Abundance account, we will be in touch to let you know if your account has been verified or if we need any further information. This will usually take 1-2 working days.
